overview_description.description:
InvestSky is a social investing app that enables people to connect with fellow investors, exchange investing ideas, and trade over 5000+ US stocks and ETFs, all with zero commission fees for as little as $1. It also provides its users advanced tools to gain insights, understand the 'whys' behind the market moves, and make better investing decisions. InvestSky aims to make investing simpler with more insights and fun for a new generation of investors in the GCC.

InvestSky is regulated by the Dubai Financial Services Authority (DFSA).

The company was founded in 2021 by Nitish Mittal and Turki Alshaikh and is headquartered in Dubai, UAE.

product.name: InvestSky Trading Platform
product.description: A commission-free platform for trading over 5,000 US stocks and ETFs, allowing users to buy fractional shares starting from $1.

product.name: Social Investing Features
product.description: A social networking component integrated into the trading platform that allows users to follow, interact, and share investment ideas with other investors.

product.name: Market Analysis and Educational Tools
product.description: Tools and resources that provide market insights, detailed analysis, and educational content to help users understand market movements and improve investment decisions.

product.name: Thematic Investment Groupings
product.description: A feature that organizes stocks into themes or sectors, allowing users to invest based on specific trends or verticals.

product.name: Fractional Share Trading
product.description: Allows users to buy portions of shares, enabling investment with as little as $1 in US stocks and ETFs.
